  Cloud Computing [IT-4045]  
  Marks: 50                                                                               Duration: 180 mins.  
  PART-A  
  Answer all the questions.  
  1)           A company is considering migrating its IT infrastructure to a cloud platform. What key  
  SLA considerations should they discuss with the cloud provider? How can a company  
  (5)  
  ensure that their cloud service provider meets the agreed-upon SLAs?  
  A)  
  B)      A startup is looking to launch a new web application quickly and cost-effectively. How  
  can SaaS help them achieve this goal?                                                          (3)  
  
  C)      In a CIA Triad what do you mean by Availability?                                               (2)  
  2)           In a cloud computing environment, three users (User A, User B, and User C) are  
  submitting tasks to a shared resource pool. The system uses a fair queueing algorithm to  
  allocate resources. Each user submits tasks at different rates and requires different  
  A)      amounts of resources.  
  • User A submits tasks at a rate of 5 tasks per minute, each requiring 2 units of resource.  
  • User B submits tasks at a rate of 3 tasks per minute, each requiring 3 units of resource.  
  • User C submits tasks at a rate of 4 tasks per minute, each requiring 1 unit of resource.  
  
  The total available resource in the system is 20 units per minute. Based on the above    (5)  
  scenario the following questions:  
  1. Calculate the total resource demand per minute for each user.  
  2. Determine the fair share of resources each user should receive per minute based on  
  their demand and the total available resources.  
  3. Calculate the number of tasks each user can complete per minute with their fair share  
  of resources.  
  4. Evaluate the system's efficiency by comparing the total resource utilization with the  
  available resources.  
  
  B)      A company wants to use suitable desktop virtualization for supporting more number of  
  users. Suggest a suitable desktop virtualization technique for them and explain.               (3)  
  
  C)      How can multi-factor authentication be used to improve security mechanisms?                    (2)  
  3)           Virat as a chief technical officer(CTO) want to adapt Virtual Local Area                       (5)  
  Network(VLAN) in his enterprise. What are the benefits of VLAN and mention the  
  steps for converting to configure the VLAN?
